thread:
jen: Kicking off RC-7 for the DB schema bump to users.v3. Artifact pinned: gcr.io/redwood/rc-7:20260321-45. Staging smoke window 30m, targeting prod promotion in ~2h if signoffs come in. Plan: kv-warm, enable migration feature-flag, canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Posting a short rollback/runbook snippet below.

deploy-bot: rc created: rc-7 (id=rc-7). CI artifacts verified, container scans green. To promote: `/deploy promote rc-7 --to prod --canary=1% --auto-ramp=20m` (dry-run: `--dry-run`). Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rc-7

sam: Running staging smoke now. I'll run basic queries + perf evals against baseline and post metrics in ~10m.

lee: Quick Q — what's the explicit rollback procedure for the migration? Need commands I can run quickly if something goes sideways. Also add a SQL check: `SELECT count(*) FROM __migrations WHERE version='v3' AND status='applied'`.

jen: Rollback summary (ops playbook):
```bash
# stop new writes behind flag
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags -d '{"flag":"users_v3_write","value":false}'
# revert migration job (if we need to undo)
kubectl -n dbjobs rollout undo job/migrate-users --to-revision=previous
# if we must revert schema changes manually (last resort)
psql -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS new_col"
# restore previous traffic slice
/deploy promote rc-6 --to staging --immediate
```
Use flag toggle first, then undo job, then manual SQL only if corruption detected.

deploy-bot: noted — recognized commands and playbook links: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/db-migrations. KV warm status: 40% prefixes cached, warming remaining shards.

ops-sheriff: I'll own sheriff for the promo window. Monitoring targets: p99 latency delta > 500ms or error rate > 0.5% will trigger immediate pause/rollback. I'll also watch DB replica lag and TCP errors.

sam: Staging smoke results: 1000 requests, p50=80ms, p95=210ms, p99=340ms, errors=0.02%. No obvious regressions. Migration record shows: 1 row applied.

jen: Tagging for signoff — @sam @lee @ops-sheriff — thumbs up to promote? :eyes: :rocket:

lee: :thumbsup: from me. Checklist: release notes updated, runbook link added, migration id and artifact pinned in PR.

ops-sheriff: :eyes: Ready to monitor. Canary ramp plan I will enforce: 1% -> 10% at +20m -> 50% at +40m -> 100% at +60m. If any threshold crosses, I'll pause and advise rollback.

jen: Promoting now. Executing: `/deploy promote rc-7 --to prod --canary=1% --auto-ramp=20m`. Holding radio silence for initial 15m.

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Job id=53721. Canary traffic shifted to rc-7: 1%. Live logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/53721. Healthchecks running: 200/200 ok.

sam: Running quick prod-canary smoke (100 requests) against canary endpoints.

sam: Smoke ok, metrics within baseline, no increased errors. p99 ~ 360ms.

ops-sheriff: 20m elapsed — ramping to 10% now per plan.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 10% complete. No alert triggers so far. Continuing auto-ramp.

jen: Noted. Will monitor metrics and DB replica dashboards.

deploy-bot: Auto-ramp to 50% initiated.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 50% complete. Observed a p99 spike to 420ms for a 5m window (alert threshold 400ms). Correlation: elevated DB replica failovers in eu-west-1.

ops-sheriff: Pausing ramp. That spike looks correlated to a replica failover, not the new code path. I'm going to roll traffic back to 10% while we confirm. Executing: `/deploy rollback 53721 --to 10%`.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed. Traffic restored to 10%. Job logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/53721/rollback. Alerts cleared.

jen: Acknowledged. We'll hold RC-7 pinned and postpone the final 100% promotion for 1h to let replicas stabilize. I'll surface incident notes and update the launch doc.

lee: +1 to hold. If replica failovers continue, we'll open a short postmortem. For now, keep RC pinned and re-evaluate in 60m.

sam: Ack — I'll re-run smoke after replica stabilizes and re-post metrics.

ops-sheriff: I'll stay on until +2h post-rollback and coordinate with DB infra to confirm replica health. If stable, we can re-run the promote with the same auto-ramp.

jen: Thanks all. New promo tentative window: +90m. Leaving RC pinned and updating release notes with the brief hold and rollback reason (eu-west-1 replica churn). :thumbsup:
